title: Burn a Binary Tree from a Target Node
problemStatement: Given the root of a binary tree and a target node, determine the minimum time required to burn the entire tree if the fire spreads every second from a burning node to its parent and children simultaneously.
input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the binary tree. • The last line contains the target node value.
output: • Print the minimum time required to burn the entire tree.
